english.title: Responsible person fail to provide equine's ID, upon request, to veterinary surgeon treating the equine
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[owner having primary day-to-day responsibility for an equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), ]_
(B)_[keeper of an equine, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUINE..), for which the owner did not have primary day-to-day responsibility and]_

which was being treated by a veterinary surgeon, namely **(..SPECIFY SURGEON..), failed, upon reasonable request from that surgeon, to provide the equine's ID to

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_

without delay
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 11, 22 and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
